text: Imagine the Sun switched off. Right now. You wouldn't know.
The light already on its way would keep arriving for eight minutes and twenty seconds.
That light could cross from the Earth to the Moon in one point three seconds.
Nothing in the universe goes faster. No matter, no energy, no message.
And still, from the Sun, it takes eight minutes.
So how close have we ever got to that speed? The fastest thing people have ever built is linked right here.
